claim: Exact executable finite reference over Global < Regional < Local; not the mutable production adapter.

declarations.name: elt
declarations.source: type elt : immutable_data = Global | Regional | Local

declarations.name: rank
declarations.source:
let[@def] (rank @ total) x = match x with
  | Global -> 0
  | Regional -> 1
  | Local -> 2

declarations.name: le
declarations.source: let[@def] (le @ total) a b = rank a <= rank b

declarations.name: join
declarations.source: let[@def] (join @ total) a b = if le a b then b else a

declarations.name: meet
declarations.source: let[@def] (meet @ total) a b = if le a b then a else b

declarations.name: regional_to_global
declarations.source:
let[@def] (regional_to_global @ total) x = match x with
  | Global | Regional -> Global
  | Local -> Local

declarations.name: regional_to_local
declarations.source:
let[@def] (regional_to_local @ total) x = match x with
  | Global -> Global
  | Regional | Local -> Local

declarations.name: term
declarations.source:
type term : immutable_data =
  | Const of elt
  | Var of int
  | Join of term * term
  | Meet of term * term
  | Regional_to_global of term
  | Table of elt * elt * elt * term
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: apply_table
declarations.source:
let[@def] (apply_table @ total) (global : elt) (regional : elt) (local : elt) value =
  match value with
  | Global -> global
  | Regional -> regional
  | Local -> local

declarations.name: qf
declarations.source:
type qf : immutable_data =
  | Le of term * term
  | And of qf * qf
  | Or of qf * qf
  | Not of qf
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: formula
declarations.source:
type formula : immutable_data =
  | Plain of qf
  | Conj of formula * formula
  | Disj of formula * formula
  | Neg of formula
  | Exists of formula
  | Forall of formula
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: lookup
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (lookup @ total) env i =
  if i < 0 then Global
  else match env with
  | [] -> Global
  | b :: rest -> if i = 0 then b else lookup rest (i - 1)

declarations.name: eval_term
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (eval_term @ total) env t =
  match t with
  | Const b -> b
  | Var i -> lookup env i
  | Join (a, b) -> join (eval_term env a) (eval_term env b)
  | Meet (a, b) -> meet (eval_term env a) (eval_term env b)
  | Regional_to_global a -> regional_to_global (eval_term env a)
  | Table (global, regional, local, a) ->
    apply_table global regional local (eval_term env a)

declarations.name: eval_qf
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (eval_qf @ total) env q =
  match q with
  | Le (a, b) -> le (eval_term env a) (eval_term env b)
  | And (a, b) -> eval_qf env a && eval_qf env b
  | Or (a, b) -> eval_qf env a || eval_qf env b
  | Not a -> not (eval_qf env a)

declarations.name: eval
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (eval @ total) env f =
  match f with
  | Plain q -> eval_qf env q
  | Conj (a, b) -> eval env a && eval env b
  | Disj (a, b) -> eval env a || eval env b
  | Neg a -> not (eval env a)
  | Exists a ->
    eval (Global :: env) a || eval (Regional :: env) a
    || eval (Local :: env) a
  | Forall a ->
    eval (Global :: env) a && eval (Regional :: env) a
    && eval (Local :: env) a

declarations.name: scoped_term
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (scoped_term @ total) depth t =
  match t with
  | Const _ -> true
  | Var i -> 0 <= i && i < depth
  | Join (a, b) | Meet (a, b) ->
    scoped_term depth a && scoped_term depth b
  | Regional_to_global a | Table (_, _, _, a) -> scoped_term depth a

declarations.name: scoped_qf
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (scoped_qf @ total) depth q =
  match q with
  | Le (a, b) -> scoped_term depth a && scoped_term depth b
  | And (a, b) | Or (a, b) ->
    scoped_qf depth a && scoped_qf depth b
  | Not a -> scoped_qf depth a

declarations.name: scoped
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (scoped @ total) depth f =
  match f with
  | Plain q -> scoped_qf depth q
  | Conj (a, b) | Disj (a, b) ->
    scoped depth a && scoped depth b
  | Neg a -> scoped depth a
  | Exists a | Forall a -> scoped (depth + 1) a

declarations.name: subsumption_formula
declarations.source:
let[@def] (subsumption_formula @ total) right obligation =
  Forall
    (Disj
       (Neg (Plain right),
        Exists (Plain obligation)))

declarations.name: le_def

val le_def :

declarations.name: join_def

val join_def :
  (a : elt) ->
  (b : elt) -> {u : unit | (join a b) === (if le a b then b else a)} @@ total

declarations.name: meet
declarations.source: val meet : elt -> elt -> elt @@ total

declarations.name: meet_def
declarations.source:
val meet_def :
  (a : elt) ->
  (b : elt) -> {u : unit | (meet a b) === (if le a b then a else b)} @@ total

declarations.name: regional_to_global
declarations.source: val regional_to_global : elt -> elt @@ total

declarations.name: regional_to_global_def
declarations.source:
val regional_to_global_def :
  (x : elt) ->
  {u : unit
    | (regional_to_global x) ===
        (match x with | Global | Regional -> Global | Local -> Local)} @@ total

declarations.name: regional_to_local
declarations.source: val regional_to_local : elt -> elt @@ total

declarations.name: regional_to_local_def
declarations.source:
val regional_to_local_def :
  (x : elt) ->
  {u : unit
    | (regional_to_local x) ===
        (match x with | Global -> Global | Regional | Local -> Local)} @@ total

declarations.source:
type term : immutable_data =
    Const of elt
  | Var of int
  | Join of term * term
  | Meet of term * term
  | Regional_to_global of term
  | Table of elt * elt * elt * term
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: apply_table
declarations.source: val apply_table : elt -> elt -> elt -> elt -> elt @@ total

declarations.name: apply_table_def
declarations.source:
val apply_table_def :
  (global : elt) ->
  (regional : elt) ->
  (local : elt) ->
  (value : elt) ->
  {u : unit
    | (apply_table global regional local value) ===
        (match value with
         | Global -> global
         | Regional -> regional
         | Local -> local)} @@ total

declarations.name: qf
declarations.source:
type qf : immutable_data = Le of term * term | And of qf * qf | Or of qf * qf | Not of qf
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: formula
declarations.source:
type formula : immutable_data =
    Plain of qf
  | Conj of formula * formula
  | Disj of formula * formula
  | Neg of formula
  | Exists of formula
  | Forall of formula
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: lookup
declarations.source: val lookup : elt list -> int -> elt @@ total

declarations.name: lookup_def
declarations.source:
val lookup_def :
  (env : elt list) ->
  (i : int) ->
  {u : unit
    | (lookup env i) ===
        (if i < 0
         then Global
         else
           (match env with
            | [] -> Global
            | b::rest -> if i = 0 then b else lookup rest (i - 1)))} @@ total

declarations.name: eval_term
declarations.source: val eval_term : elt list -> term -> elt @@ total

declarations.name: eval_term_def
declarations.source:
val eval_term_def :
  (env : elt list) ->
  (t : term) ->
  {u : unit
    | (eval_term env t) ===
        (match t with
         | Const b' -> b'
         | Var i -> lookup env i
         | Join (a', b'') -> join (eval_term env a') (eval_term env b'')
         | Meet (a'', b) -> meet (eval_term env a'') (eval_term env b)
         | Regional_to_global a''' -> regional_to_global (eval_term env a''')
         | Table (global, regional, local, a) ->
             apply_table global regional local (eval_term env a))} @@ total

declarations.name: eval_qf
declarations.source: val eval_qf : elt list -> qf -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: eval_qf_def
declarations.source:
val eval_qf_def :
  (env : elt list) ->
  (q : qf) ->
  {u : unit
    | (eval_qf env q) ===
        (match q with
         | Le (a', b') -> le (eval_term env a') (eval_term env b')
         | And (a'', b'') -> (eval_qf env a'') && (eval_qf env b'')
         | Or (a''', b) -> (eval_qf env a''') || (eval_qf env b)
         | Not a -> not (eval_qf env a))} @@ total

declarations.name: eval
declarations.source: val eval : elt list -> formula -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: eval_def
declarations.source:
val eval_def :
  (env : elt list) ->
  (f : formula) ->
  {u : unit
    | (eval env f) ===
        (match f with
         | Plain q -> eval_qf env q
         | Conj (a', b') -> (eval env a') && (eval env b')
         | Disj (a'', b) -> (eval env a'') || (eval env b)
         | Neg a''' -> not (eval env a''')
         | Exists a'''' ->
             (eval (Global :: env) a'''') ||
               ((eval (Regional :: env) a'''') || (eval (Local :: env) a''''))
         | Forall a ->
             (eval (Global :: env) a) &&
               ((eval (Regional :: env) a) && (eval (Local :: env) a)))} @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_term
declarations.source: val scoped_term : int -> term -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_term_def
declarations.source:
val scoped_term_def :
  (depth : int) ->
  (t : term) ->
  {u : unit
    | (scoped_term depth t) ===
        (match t with
         | Const _ -> true
         | Var i -> (0 <= i) && (i < depth)
         | Join (a', b) | Meet (a', b) ->
             (scoped_term depth a') && (scoped_term depth b)
         | Regional_to_global a | Table (_, _, _, a) -> scoped_term depth a)} @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_qf
declarations.source: val scoped_qf : int -> qf -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_qf_def
declarations.source:
val scoped_qf_def :
  (depth : int) ->
  (q : qf) ->
  {u : unit
    | (scoped_qf depth q) ===
        (match q with
         | Le (a', b') -> (scoped_term depth a') && (scoped_term depth b')
         | And (a'', b) | Or (a'', b) ->
             (scoped_qf depth a'') && (scoped_qf depth b)
         | Not a -> scoped_qf depth a)} @@ total

declarations.name: scoped
declarations.source: val scoped : int -> formula -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_def
declarations.source:
val scoped_def :
  (depth : int) ->
  (f : formula) ->
  {u : unit
    | (scoped depth f) ===
        (match f with
         | Plain q -> scoped_qf depth q
         | Conj (a', b) | Disj (a', b) ->
             (scoped depth a') && (scoped depth b)
         | Neg a'' -> scoped depth a''
         | Exists a | Forall a -> scoped (depth + 1) a)} @@ total

declarations.name: subsumption_formula
declarations.source: val subsumption_formula : qf -> qf -> formula @@ total

declarations.name: subsumption_formula_def
declarations.source:
val subsumption_formula_def :
  (right : qf) ->
  (obligation : qf) ->
  {u : unit
    | (subsumption_formula right obligation) ===
        (Forall (Disj ((Neg (Plain right)), (Exists (Plain obligation)))))} @@ total

declarations.name: inequality
declarations.source: type inequality : immutable_data = { left : term; right : term }

declarations.name: graph
declarations.source: type graph : immutable_data = inequality list

declarations.name: models
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (models @ total) env graph =
  match graph with
  | [] -> true
  | edge :: rest ->
    le (eval_term env edge.left) (eval_term env edge.right)
    && models env rest

declarations.name: scoped_graph
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (scoped_graph @ total) depth graph =
  match graph with
  | [] -> true
  | edge :: rest ->
    scoped_term depth edge.left && scoped_term depth edge.right
    && scoped_graph depth rest

declarations.name: models_exists
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (models_exists @ total) (count : unit list) env graph =
  match count with
  | [] -> models env graph
  | _ :: rest ->
    models_exists rest (Global :: env) graph
    || models_exists rest (Regional :: env) graph
    || models_exists rest (Local :: env) graph

declarations.name: scoped_exists
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (scoped_exists @ total) (count : unit list) depth graph =
  match count with
  | [] -> scoped_graph depth graph
  | _ :: rest -> scoped_exists rest (depth + 1) graph

graph

declarations.name: models
declarations.source: val models : Mode_solver_semantics.elt list -> inequality list -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: models_def
declarations.source:
val models_def :
  (env : Mode_solver_semantics.elt list) ->
  (graph : inequality list) ->
  {u : unit
    | (models env graph) ===
        (match graph with
         | [] -> true
         | edge::rest ->
             (Mode_solver_semantics.le
                (Mode_solver_semantics.eval_term env edge.left)
                (Mode_solver_semantics.eval_term env edge.right))
               && (models env rest))} @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_graph
declarations.source: val scoped_graph : int -> inequality list -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_graph_def
declarations.source:
val scoped_graph_def :
  (depth : int) ->
  (graph : inequality list) ->
  {u : unit
    | (scoped_graph depth graph) ===
        (match graph with
         | [] -> true
         | edge::rest ->
             (Mode_solver_semantics.scoped_term depth edge.left) &&
               ((Mode_solver_semantics.scoped_term depth edge.right) &&
                  (scoped_graph depth rest)))} @@ total

declarations.name: models_exists
declarations.source:
val models_exists :
  unit list -> Mode_solver_semantics.elt list -> inequality list -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: models_exists_def
declarations.source:
val models_exists_def :
  (count : unit list) ->
  (env : Mode_solver_semantics.elt list) ->
  (graph : inequality list) ->
  {u : unit
    | (models_exists count env graph) ===
        (match count with
         | [] -> models env graph
         | _::rest ->
             (models_exists rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) graph)
               ||
               ((models_exists rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env)
                   graph)
                  ||
                  (models_exists rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env)
                     graph)))} @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_exists
declarations.source: val scoped_exists : unit list -> int -> inequality list -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_exists_def
declarations.source:
val scoped_exists_def :
  (count : unit list) ->
  (depth : int) ->
  (graph : inequality list) ->
  {u : unit
    | (scoped_exists count depth graph) ===
        (match count with
         | [] -> scoped_graph depth graph
         | _::rest -> scoped_exists rest (depth + 1) graph)} @@ total

declarations.name: quantifier
declarations.source: type quantifier : immutable_data = Universal | Existential

declarations.name: admissible
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (admissible @ total) (prefix : quantifier list) env guard =
  match prefix with
  | [] -> eval_qf env guard
  | _ :: rest ->
    admissible rest (Global :: env) guard
    || admissible rest (Regional :: env) guard
    || admissible rest (Local :: env) guard

declarations.name: game
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (game @ total) prefix env guard witness =
  match prefix with
  | [] -> eval_qf env witness
  | Existential :: rest ->
    (admissible rest (Global :: env) guard
     && game rest (Global :: env) guard witness)
    || (admissible rest (Regional :: env) guard
        && game rest (Regional :: env) guard witness)
    || (admissible rest (Local :: env) guard
        && game rest (Local :: env) guard witness)
  | Universal :: rest ->
    (not (admissible rest (Global :: env) guard)
     || game rest (Global :: env) guard witness)
    && (not (admissible rest (Regional :: env) guard)
        || game rest (Regional :: env) guard witness)
    && (not (admissible rest (Local :: env) guard)
        || game rest (Local :: env) guard witness)

declarations.name: append_prefix
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (append_prefix @ total) (outer : quantifier list) (inner : quantifier list) =
  match outer with
  | [] -> inner
  | head :: rest -> head :: append_prefix rest inner

declarations.name: normalized_game
declarations.source:
let[@def] (normalized_game @ total) prefix env guard witness =
  admissible prefix env guard && game prefix env guard witness

declarations.name: scoped_prefix
declarations.source:
let[@def] rec (scoped_prefix @ total) (prefix : quantifier list) depth q =
  match prefix with
  | [] -> scoped_qf depth q
  | _ :: rest -> scoped_prefix rest (depth + 1) q

declarations.name: quantifier
declarations.source: type quantifier : immutable_data = Universal | Existential

declarations.name: admissible
declarations.source:
val admissible :
  quantifier list ->
  Mode_solver_semantics.elt list -> Mode_solver_semantics.qf -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: admissible_def
declarations.source:
val admissible_def :
  (prefix : quantifier list) ->
  (env : Mode_solver_semantics.elt list) ->
  (guard : Mode_solver_semantics.qf) ->
  {u : unit
    | (admissible prefix env guard) ===
        (match prefix with
         | [] -> Mode_solver_semantics.eval_qf env guard
         | _::rest ->
             (admissible rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) guard) ||
               ((admissible rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env)
                   guard)
                  ||
                  (admissible rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env) guard)))} @@ total

declarations.name: game
declarations.source:
val game :
  quantifier list ->
  Mode_solver_semantics.elt list ->
  Mode_solver_semantics.qf -> Mode_solver_semantics.qf -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: game_def
declarations.source:
val game_def :
  (prefix : quantifier list) ->
  (env : Mode_solver_semantics.elt list) ->
  (guard : Mode_solver_semantics.qf) ->
  (witness : Mode_solver_semantics.qf) ->
  {u : unit
    | (game prefix env guard witness) ===
        (match prefix with
         | [] -> Mode_solver_semantics.eval_qf env witness
         | (Existential)::rest' ->
             ((admissible rest' (Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) guard)
                &&
                (game rest' (Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) guard
                   witness))
               ||
               (((admissible rest' (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env)
                    guard)
                   &&
                   (game rest' (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env) guard
                      witness))
                  ||
                  ((admissible rest' (Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env)
                      guard)
                     &&
                     (game rest' (Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env) guard
                        witness)))
         | (Universal)::rest ->
             ((not
                 (admissible rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) guard))
                ||
                (game rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) guard
                   witness))
               &&
               (((not
                    (admissible rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env)
                       guard))
                   ||
                   (game rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env) guard
                      witness))
                  &&
                  ((not
                      (admissible rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env)
                         guard))
                     ||
                     (game rest (Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env) guard
                        witness))))} @@ total

declarations.name: append_prefix
declarations.source: val append_prefix : quantifier list -> quantifier list -> quantifier list @@ total

declarations.name: append_prefix_def
declarations.source:
val append_prefix_def :
  (outer : quantifier list) ->
  (inner : quantifier list) ->
  {u : unit
    | (append_prefix outer inner) ===
        (match outer with
         | [] -> inner
         | head::rest -> head :: (append_prefix rest inner))} @@ total

declarations.name: normalized_game
declarations.source:
val normalized_game :
  quantifier list ->
  Mode_solver_semantics.elt list ->
  Mode_solver_semantics.qf -> Mode_solver_semantics.qf -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: normalized_game_def
declarations.source:
val normalized_game_def :
  (prefix : quantifier list) ->
  (env : Mode_solver_semantics.elt list) ->
  (guard : Mode_solver_semantics.qf) ->
  (witness : Mode_solver_semantics.qf) ->
  {u : unit
    | (normalized_game prefix env guard witness) ===
        ((admissible prefix env guard) && (game prefix env guard witness))} @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_prefix
declarations.source:
val scoped_prefix :
  quantifier list -> int -> Mode_solver_semantics.qf -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: scoped_prefix_def
declarations.source:
val scoped_prefix_def :
  (prefix : quantifier list) ->
  (depth : int) ->
  (q : Mode_solver_semantics.qf) ->
  {u : unit
    | (scoped_prefix prefix depth q) ===
        (match prefix with
         | [] -> Mode_solver_semantics.scoped_qf depth q
         | _::rest -> scoped_prefix rest (depth + 1) q)} @@ total

declarations.name: regionality_adjunction
declarations.source:
val regionality_adjunction :
  (a : Mode_solver_semantics.elt) ->
  ((b : Mode_solver_semantics.elt) ->
   {u : unit
     | (Mode_solver_semantics.le (Mode_solver_semantics.regional_to_local a)
          b)
         =
         (Mode_solver_semantics.le a
            (Mode_solver_semantics.regional_to_global b))}) @ total
  stateful @@ total

declarations.name: eliminate
declarations.source: val eliminate : Mode_solver_semantics.formula -> Mode_solver_semantics.qf @@ total

declarations.name: eliminate_exact
declarations.source:
val eliminate_exact :
  (env : Mode_solver_semantics.elt list) ->
  ((f : Mode_solver_semantics.formula) ->
   {u : unit
     | (Mode_solver_semantics.eval_qf env (eliminate f)) =
         (Mode_solver_semantics.eval env f)}) @ total
  stateful @@ total

declarations.name: eliminate_scoped
declarations.source:
val eliminate_scoped :
  (depth : int) ->
  ((f : {f : Mode_solver_semantics.formula
          | Mode_solver_semantics.scoped depth f}) ->
   {u : unit | Mode_solver_semantics.scoped_qf depth (eliminate f)}) @ total
  stateful @@ total

declarations.name: decide_checked
declarations.source:
val decide_checked :
  (f : Mode_solver_semantics.formula) ->
  {answer : bool option
    | match answer with
      | None -> not (Mode_solver_semantics.scoped 0 f)
      | Some value ->
          (Mode_solver_semantics.scoped 0 f) &&
            (value = (Mode_solver_semantics.eval [] f))} @@ total

declarations.name: project_graph

declarations.source:
val decide_graph_checked :
  (count : unit list) ->
  (graph : Mode_solver_graph_semantics.graph) ->
  {answer : bool option
    | match answer with
      | None -> not (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.scoped_exists count 0 graph)
      | Some value ->
          (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.scoped_exists count 0 graph) &&
            (value =
               (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models_exists count [] graph))} @@ total

   (witness : Mode_solver_semantics.qf) ->
   {u : unit
     | (project_guarded
          (Mode_solver_guarded_semantics.append_prefix outer inner) guard
          witness)
         ===
         (project_guarded outer (project_guarded inner guard witness).domain
            (project_guarded inner guard witness).winning)}) @ total
  stateful @@ total

declarations.name: assert_graph_subsumption_exact
declarations.source:
val assert_graph_subsumption_exact :
  (env : Mode_solver_semantics.elt list) ->
  ((gamma : Mode_solver_semantics.qf) ->
   (guard : Mode_solver_graph_semantics.graph) ->
   (obligations : Mode_solver_graph_semantics.graph) ->
   {u : unit
     | (Mode_solver_semantics.eval_qf env
          (assert_graph_subsumption gamma guard obligations))
         =
         ((Mode_solver_semantics.eval_qf env gamma) &&
            (((not
                 (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                    (Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) guard))
                ||
                ((Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                    (Mode_solver_semantics.Global ::
                    Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) obligations)
                   ||
                   ((Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                       (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional ::
                       Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) obligations)
                      ||
                      (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                         (Mode_solver_semantics.Local ::
                         Mode_solver_semantics.Global :: env) obligations))))
               &&
               (((not
                    (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                       (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env) guard))
                   ||
                   ((Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                       (Mode_solver_semantics.Global ::
                       Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env) obligations)
                      ||
                      ((Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                          (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional ::
                          Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env) obligations)
                         ||
                         (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                            (Mode_solver_semantics.Local ::
                            Mode_solver_semantics.Regional :: env)
                            obligations))))
                  &&
                  ((not
                      (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                         (Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env) guard))
                     ||
                     ((Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                         (Mode_solver_semantics.Global ::
                         Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env) obligations)
                        ||
                        ((Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                            (Mode_solver_semantics.Regional ::
                            Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env) obligations)
                           ||
                           (Mode_solver_graph_semantics.models
                              (Mode_solver_semantics.Local ::
                              Mode_solver_semantics.Local :: env) obligations)))))))}) @ total
  stateful @@ total

              | Mode_solver_semantics.scoped_qf depth gamma}) ->

              | Mode_solver_graph_semantics.scoped_graph (depth + 1) guard}) ->
   (obligations : {obligations : Mode_solver_graph_semantics.graph
                    | Mode_solver_graph_semantics.scoped_graph (depth + 2)
                        obligations}) ->
   {u : unit
     | Mode_solver_semantics.scoped_qf depth
         (assert_graph_subsumption gamma guard obligations)}) @ total
  stateful @@ total
